explanation: The null check must come first: calling name.length() on a null reference would throw a NullPointerException before any other check ever ran. len must be computed before either length check that reads it. The len == 0 check must come before name.charAt(0) — charAt(0) on an empty string throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException, so ruling out length 0 first is what makes the digit check on index 0 safe. The length-too-long and starts-with-digit checks are independent of each other and can run in either order once len is known and non-zero, with the plain 0 as the final fallback for a valid name.
prompt: Drag these statements into the order that makes validateUsername() check name safely, without ever crashing on a null or empty string.
